Only RN-web environment console noise (useNativeDriver / props.pointerEvents) — no functional issues. Save was NOT tapped (read-only mandate — real Zoho account). rca_of_issue: Original symptom: tapping 'Load Zoho locations' returned HTTP 502 with a generic HTML page (ingress fallback). Root cause: /api/zoho/locations wrapped Zoho failures with HTTPException(502). Kubernetes ingress intercepts 502 responses and replaces the body with its own HTML (losing the JSON {detail}), so the Expo client's api() helper found no JSON to parse. Separately, the user had never selected an organization (OAuth callback had stored two orgs but no organization_id), so Zoho responded 401 to /organizations/{id}/locations which bubbled up as the error. Fixes verified: (1) /zoho/locations now raises HTTPException(400, 'Pick your Zoho organization first ...') when organization_id is empty; (2) Zoho errors are mapped to HTTPException(424, str(e)) which the ingress does NOT rewrite, so the Expo toast surfaces the real cause; (3) OAuth callback auto-picks the org with the most locations (user landed on 7007711688); (4) org chips render as 'name · id' so the user can tell the two 'Sis.demo'/'sis.demo' orgs apart; (5) Load locations auto-maps QLD/NSW by name using regex /queensland|\bqld\b/i and /new south wales|\bnsw\b/i. All five fixes exercised and PASS.
